_doc: What a Task Contract's leader says (contract_system.gd, docs/make_it_fun.md A0/A1). `forecast`: the odds read before sealing (contracts.forecast(plan, leader)). Each of the plan's abort conditions gets a chance from what the tribe knows (the fog applies: only seen beasts, found dens, met clans), from the same things that would fire it in _check_aborts: enemy_attack (base by kind; seen beasts and rival warriors near the site or the way there; a found den; hostile clans; the unknown when no one has seen the site; longer walks count more, `dist_ref` world units = x1, clamped to `dist_mult`), natural_disaster (the season's disaster weathers: chance per weather roll x rolls in `days` of the kind (default_aborts: the conditions forecast before a plan is on the table); the spring flood's daily chance; weather already announced), leader_wounded (an hp_below_N% condition: the fight chance x `wound` scaled by N and the leader's combat level; more if already hurt) and heavy_losses (war: the clan's warriors against the crew's strength). risk = 1 - product(1 - each); chances are scaled by the hardship level (hz.mult) and lowered while the director shows mercy. `bands`: the spoken odds, the first whose `below` is above the risk; `voices` (`<archetype>:low|high`, high = risk >= high_at) colour the words, never the number. `reasons`: the evidence texts (vars in order shown). `log`: the field log during execution (A1): `talk` holds lines per trigger, `<trigger>:<archetype>` lines are preferred when there are some (chance `arch_chance`); triggers: progress_25/50/75, first_built (%s structure), step_done (%s step), level_up (%s person), landmark (%s place), weather (%s weather), nightfall, near_miss (%s person, below near_miss_hp of their health), chatter (when nothing was said for chatter_secs of contract time), done; and the callbacks to the forecast: quiet:<reason> at 50% if the top-forecast trouble has not come, foreseen:<reason> when the contract is interrupted for its top-forecast reason, unforeseen otherwise. Every line goes to the contract's own log (the panel); the leader also says it aloud with chance `bubble_chance` (always for callbacks); only `chronicle` triggers also reach the chronicle.

bands.text: One time in eight, something goes wrong.
One time in four, trouble finds us.
One time in three, trouble finds us.
Even odds that trouble finds us.
More likely than not, trouble finds us.
Trouble will find us, I am all but sure.

voices.warrior:low: Good. I hoped for a fight.
voices.warrior:high: Let it come. We will be ready.
voices.cautious:low: Still, we go with eyes open.
voices.cautious:high: We should go well armed, or not at all.
voices.mystic:high: The spirits are restless. We should make an offering.
voices.agrarian:low: Pack food for the road and we will be fine.
voices.agrarian:high: Pack extra food. We may be out longer than we hope.

beasts.text: Beasts were seen near the way there: %d of them.

warriors.text: Rival warriors were seen near the way there: %d of them.

den.text: There is a saber-tooth den not far from that land.

hostile.text: The %s are hostile and roam the land.

unknown.text: No one has seen that land. Anything may wait there.

quiet.text: No beasts have been seen that way.

war.text: They will fight for their homes.

blizzard.text: It is the season of blizzards.

weather.text: Bad weather comes this time of year.

incoming.text: The sky is turning; weather is coming.

fight.text: If it comes to a fight, I may be hurt.

outnumbered.text: They have about %d warriors to our %d.

match.text: We are about as many as their warriors: %d to our %d.

_judged_doc: Troubles the leader decides in the field without pausing the game (the chieftain already ordered the fight): a reason in `judged` within `secs` of a fight the chieftain answered (or of the defence it led to) is resolved with the effect for the leader's archetype, and the leader says the judged:<effect> line.

progress_25: A quarter of the work is done.
progress_25:lazy: A quarter done. That is enough for a rest, surely.
progress_50:cautious: Halfway, and no one hurt. Keep it so.
progress_50:mystic: Halfway. The spirits have let us work.
progress_75: Three parts of four done. One more push.
progress_75:agrarian: Nearly done. I can smell the cooking fires of home.
first_built: We raised a %s. This place is ours now.
first_built:mystic: The %s stands. I will bless it tonight.
level_up: Look at %s work. They are learning.
landmark: We found %s. The chieftain will want to know.
nightfall: Dark. Bank the fire and sleep.
near_miss: %s is hurt. Stay close to each other.
chatter: Mind the edges of the clearing.
chatter:warrior: I hear something. No, only the wind.
chatter:cautious: Check the ground before you step.
chatter:mystic: Do you hear the birds? A good sign.
chatter:lazy: Is it time to eat yet?
Slowly, slowly. No need to rush.
done: It is done. We go home.
quiet:enemy_attack: No sign of the beasts yet.
Halfway, and the beasts have kept away.
quiet:natural_disaster: Halfway, and the weather has spared us.
quiet:leader_wounded: Halfway, and not a scratch on me.
quiet:heavy_losses: They have not broken us yet.
foreseen:enemy_attack: They found us, as I feared.
foreseen:natural_disaster: The weather turned, as I feared.
foreseen:leader_wounded: I said I might be hurt. I am.
foreseen:heavy_losses: Too many of us are down. I feared this.
judged:rest: I am hurt. I will rest by the fire; the others carry on.
judged:rest:agrarian: I am hurt. Carry on without me; I will be back when I can stand.
judged:press_on: It is only blood. We work on.
unforeseen: This I did not see coming.
No one could have read this.

_events_doc: Small happenings on a contract that the leader settles without pausing the game (contract_system._events / happen(); make_it_fun A2/A3). Every every_secs of working time (a range), with chance, one event whose when holds (kinds, progress [min, max], cond: story conditions) and that this contract has not had yet happens; weight makes it likelier. pair: rivals / friends needs two of the crew bonded that way (a, b). The leader picks an option, weighted by arch (their archetype; 1 if not listed), and its do runs as story actions. Texts may use vars plan, leader, one (one of the crew), a, b; actions may use leader_who, one_who, a_who, b_who, crew_who (people specs).

text: %s cuts into a wasp nest in the timber.

options.label: Smoke them out first
options.result: The work waits while the smoke does its job. No one is stung.

options.label: Work through it
result: %s is stung badly, but the timber is cut.

list.text: The dried meat the crew carried has gone bad.

options.label: Send for more from the stores
options.result: Fresh food comes from the village: 8 from the stores.

options.label: Tighten belts until evening
options.result: The crew works hungry and says so.

list.text: Strange tracks circle the camp in the night.

options.label: Follow them

do.remember: followed strange tracks from the camp on Day %d

result: %s follows them into the grass and comes back wiser about the land.

options.label: Keep close to the fire
options.result: No one sleeps far from the fire that night.

list.text: A white raven settles on the work and watches.

options.label: Leave it an offering
options.result: A little food is left out. The raven eats, and the crew takes heart.

options.label: Shoo it away
options.result: The raven flies off. Some of the crew mutter about bad luck.

list.text: The crew finds a spring of clear, cold water.

options.label: Rest a while beside it
options.result: They drink, wash and rest. The work goes better after.

options.label: Mark it and work on
options.result: The spring is marked for later. The work does not stop.

text: %s and %s come to blows over who does the heavy work.

options.label: Set them apart
options.result: They work at opposite ends of the camp and do not speak.

options.label: Let them fight it out
options.result: A short, ugly fight. After it, a grudging respect.

options.label: Make them carry the logs together
options.result: They grumble under the same log all afternoon, and by evening they are laughing at it.

text: %s and %s sing as they work, and the others join in.

options.label: Let them sing
options.result: The work goes to the beat of the song.

options.label: Quiet: the beasts will hear
options.result: The singing stops. The work goes on in silence.
